class.name: com.simplysoftware.ModbusSerialRTU.ModbusSerialRTU
class.comment: ModbusSerialDesktop - Serial implementation for desktop applications. This library provides robust Modbus RTU communication via jSerialComm.
class.event: InitResult(Success As Boolean, Message As String)
CoilRead(Success As Boolean, Data() As Boolean, Message As String)
DiscreteInputRead(Success As Boolean, Data() As Boolean, Message As String)
HoldingRegisterRead(Success As Boolean, Data() As Short, Message As String)
InputRegisterRead(Success As Boolean, Data() As Short, Message As String)
WriteResult(Success As Boolean, Message As String)
ConnectionCheckDone(IsLive As Boolean, Message As String)
DiagnosticRequest(SubFunction As Int, Data As Int)
TestCompleted(Success As Boolean, Message As String)
Disconnected(Success As Boolean, Message As String)
FloatRead(Success As Boolean, Value As Float, Data() As Float, Message As String)
Int32Read(Success As Boolean, Value As Int, Message As String)
FloatArrayRead(Success As Boolean, Values() As Float, Data() As Float, Message As String)
Int32ArrayRead(Success As Boolean, Values() As Int, Message As String)

method.name: BytesToFloat
method.comment: Enhanced BytesToFloat that respects the selected ByteOrderMode.

method.name: TestFunction
method.comment: Executes a self-test based on the configured TestFunction and TestAddress. Results are returned asynchronously in the TestCompleted and ConnectionCheckDone events.

method.name: Connected
method.comment: Returns whether the serial port is currently open and connected. Return true if connected, otherwise false.

method.name: BytesToInt32
method.comment: Enhanced BytesToInt32 that respects the selected ByteOrderMode.

method.name: IsInitialized
method.comment: Checks if the object is initialized. Return true if initialized, otherwise false.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initialises the Modbus RTU object and sets the event prefix callbacks. EventName The event prefix used for raised events.

method.name: ListPorts
method.comment: Returns a list of available serial ports on the system, sorted numerically (COM1, COM2, COM3, COM10, etc).

method.name: Disconnect
method.comment: Closes the active serial connection. Raises the Disconnected event when complete.

method.name: SetParameters
method.comment: Sets the serial communication parameters for the port. BaudRate Speed in bits per second. DataBits Number of data bits per character. StopBits Number of stop bits. Parity Parity mode (0=None, 1=Odd, 2=Even, 3=Mark, 4=Space).

method.name: ReadWriteMultipleRegisters
method.comment: Read/Write Multiple Registers helper. Performs a write (FC16) followed by a read (FC3) as two distinct transactions. All values are treated as unsigned 16-bit. Returns the read blocksynchronously and also raises HoldingRegisterRead and WriteResult events.

method.name: FloatToRegisters
method.comment: Converts a 32-bit Float into two 16-bit registers (Hi/Lo). Returns an Int array where index 0 is high and index 1 is low.

method.name: ReadFloatArray
method.comment: Reads an array of 32-bit floats from holding registers. Address The starting register address. Count Number of float values to read (each uses 2 registers). Return an array of float values. Raises FloatArrayRead event with the result.

method.name: ReadDiscreteInputs
method.comment: Reads discrete input values (Function Code 2). Start The 0-based starting input address. Len Number of inputs to read. Results are returned asynchronously in the DiscreteInputRead event.

method.name: WriteFloat
method.comment: Writes a 32-bit float to two holding registers. Address The starting register address.

method.name: DiagnosticRequest
method.comment: Diagnostic Request (Function Code 8). SubFunction - The diagnostic sub-function code. Data - The data value to send. This implementation currently handles SubFunction 0 (Loopback/Echo). Raises the DiagnosticRequest event.

method.name: WriteCoils
method.comment: Writes multiple coil values (Function Code 15). Start The 0-based starting coil address. Values Array of boolean values to write. Results are returned asynchronously in the WriteResult event.

method.name: ReadHoldingRegisters
method.comment: Reads holding registers (Function Code 3). Start The 0-based starting register address. Len Number of registers to read. Return an array of unsigned 16-bit values. Results are also returned asynchronously in the HoldingRegisterRead event.

method.name: WriteInt32
method.comment: Writes a 32-bit signed integer to two holding registers. Address The starting register address.

method.name: ReadInt32
method.comment: Reads a 32-bit integer from two holding registers. Address The starting register address. Return the reconstructed 32-bit integer. Raises Int32Read event with the result.

method.name: WriteFloatArray
method.comment: Writes an array of 32-bit floating point values (IEEE 754). Each float occupies 2 consecutive holding registers. Start - The 0-based starting register address. Values - Array of floats to write. Results are returned asynchronously in the WriteResult event.

method.name: Connect
method.comment: Connects to the specified serial port using the configured parameters. PortName The system name of the port (e.g., "COM3", "/dev/ttyUSB0"). Raises the InitResult event when complete.

method.name: ReadCoils
method.comment: Reads coil values (Function Code 1). Start The 0-based starting coil address. Len Number of coils to read. Results are returned asynchronously in the CoilRead event.

method.name: WriteInt32Array
method.comment: Writes an array of 32-bit signed integer to two holding registers. Address The starting register address.

method.name: BytesToFloatFromFloats
method.comment: Overloaded helper that accepts a Float array and re-converts it using the current ByteOrderMode.

method.name: WriteRegister
method.comment: Writes a single holding register (Function Code 6). Offset The 0-based register address. Value The 16-bit value to write. Results are returned asynchronously in the WriteResult event.

method.name: ReconvertFloat
method.comment: Re-shuffles a float's internal bits based on the current ByteOrderMode. Use this when you want to see how different modes affect the same value.

method.name: ReadFloat
method.comment: Reads a 32-bit float from two holding registers. Address The starting register address. Raises the FloatRead event when complete.

method.name: WriteCoil
method.comment: Writes a single coil value (Function Code 5). Offset The 0-based coil address. Value The boolean value to write. Results are returned asynchronously in the WriteResult event.

method.name: ReadInputRegisters
method.comment: Reads input registers (Function Code 4). Start The 0-based starting register address. Len Number of registers to read. Return an array of unsigned 16-bit values. Results are also returned asynchronously in the InputRegisterRead event.

method.name: WriteRegisters
method.comment: Writes multiple holding registers (Function Code 16). Start The 0-based starting register address. Values Array of 16-bit values to write. Results are returned asynchronously in the WriteResult event.

method.name: RaiseFloatRead
method.comment: Converts a 4-byte array to a Float and raises the FloatRead event. Useful for processing raw Modbus responses into high-level logic.

method.name: ReadInt32Array
method.comment: Reads an array of 32-bit integers from holding registers. Address The starting register address. Count Number of Int32 values to read (each uses 2 registers). Return an array of 32-bit integers. Raises Int32ArrayRead event with the result.

method.name: RaiseFloatArrayRead
method.comment: Converts a byte array into multiple Floats (4 bytes per float) and raises FloatArrayRead.

method.name: SetTestConfig
method.comment: Configures the test function used by TestFunction(). TestFunction The type of register to read for the test (use TEST_ constants). TestAddress The 0-based address to read for the test.

method.name: RegistersToFloat
method.comment: Converts two 16-bit registers (Hi/Lo) into a 32-bit Float. Uses BIG_ENDIAN format for high/low register pairs.

property.name: PortNames
property.comment: Returns the name of the currently connected serial device. Return the device name, or an empty string if not connected.

field.name: PostReadDelay
field.comment: Property: Sets the post read delay in ms(milliseconds). Set between (50–250) if you are having concurrent read issues. The default value is 0.

field.name: ORDER_CDAB
field.comment: Word Swap: Swaps the high and low 16-bit words (e.g., 0x43 0x44 0x41 0x42)

field.name: SlaveID
field.comment: Property: Gets or sets the Modbus Slave Unit ID (1–247). The default value is 1.

field.name: GapReadWriteMultipleDelay
field.comment: Property: Sets the gap read write multiple delay in ms(milliseconds). Set between (50–250) if you are having GapReadWriteMultipleDelay issues. The default value is 0.

field.name: PostWriteDelay
field.comment: Property: Sets the post write delay in ms(milliseconds). Set between (50–250) if you are having concurrent write issues. The default value is 0.

field.name: ORDER_BADC
field.comment: Byte Swap: Swaps bytes within each 16-bit word (e.g., 0x42 0x41 0x44 0x43)

field.name: ByteOrderMode
field.comment: Sets the byte order used for 32-bit data conversions (Float and Int32). Defaults to ORDER_ABCD (Big-Endian).
